cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Wonderful, we can take a brush for the picnic crumbs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. I'm carrying all the sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Perfect. Grab the picnic blanket without climbing stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar. The sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Built-in refrigeration. Put them beside the wine; this door is catering.

mechanism: A transforms a malfunctioning door itinerary into benefits while correcting its former pupil picnic preparations as if this is advanced packing.
confusable: Not inventing a new secret mission: the same picnic goal is served by each wrong destination.
comparison: Domestic preparation using accidental destinations versus workplace time reversal preventing an unnecessary meeting.
